activity_summary: John would not name a share while the bag was unshut. You recalled last Saturday as six-and-thirty and did not ask him to better it. Pope said Titus went and that you were not in it. You said you were at the board, and the bill was left as a bill. The Rose's bill for today is marked paid, the Revels' fee, and John would not add a sum. Burbage asked after the glass. You said the line is struck and none is bought. You left without a figure.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named last Saturday's 36s, refused a guess, and kept the glass struck.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Withheld tonight's share and any Rose sum he had not got.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked for a number, said Titus went without Will, and did not invent one on the road.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the bill and the board as two truths, and waited on the glass.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The bag is not shut. I will not name a share while it is open.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: It is marked paid. It is the Revels' fee.
